name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light mode toggle** visible in the top-right corner.

Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light conditions and align with user expectations from competitive dashboards like Manus and Graphify. The toggle ensures accessibility without disrupting the interface’s liveliness or clarity. Trade-off: some users may prefer light mode in bright environments, but the default dark theme prioritizes consistency and visual impact.

name: Pane
text: A system-wide dark theme with a toggle still forces glare-sensitive users to endure the default glare of the dark theme before toggling—glare sensitivity isn’t just about brightness, it’s about contrast. Instead, default to **light mode** with a persistent dark mode toggle, matching the Manus and Graphify dashboards’ flexibility without penalizing users who need it most. Settle this by testing glare-sensitive users in both modes—if dark mode’s contrast still strains them, the default must flip.

name: Facet
text:
Default to **light mode** with a persistent dark mode toggle in the top-right corner.

Light mode reduces glare for sensitive users immediately, while the toggle gives others the option to switch. This matches Manus and Graphify’s approach, ensuring accessibility without forcing a high-contrast dark theme on everyone. The trade-off is that dark theme enthusiasts must click once, but clarity and comfort win for the widest audience.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Defaulting to light mode ignores users who work in bright environments—glare isn’t just a sensitivity issue, it’s situational. A better alternative is a **system-aware theme** that detects ambient light and auto-switches, with manual overrides. Settle it with user testing in both bright and dark conditions, measuring task completion time and reported strain.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to **system-aware theme** (auto-switching between light/dark based on ambient light) with a **persistent, non-modal toggle** for manual override in the top-right corner.

Result: A theme system that adapts to user environments while ensuring glare-sensitive users aren’t forced into high-contrast modes. Owned by Facet (visualization-w1).
